verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's API surface (search, register, DNS, renewals, lock, transfer) is fully programmatic and could be scripted across many domains, and pricing docs note no limit on the number of domains registered at member rates, implying portfolio-scale usage is supported. However, none of the docs mention dedicated bulk/batch endpoints (e.g., bulk transfer, bulk nameserver update, bulk renewal in one call) — all examples (curl, gddy CLI) operate on a single domain at a time, requiring the user to loop calls themselves. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or CLI flags for multi-domain search, registration, renewal, nameserver changes, and transfers; independent confirmation that bulk workflows work at scale.
